name: model-tier
description: Routes each main-loop turn to fable, opus, sonnet or haiku and a reasoning effort by task complexity, with a set_tier tool the model calls to correct either

downgradeAfterTurns.title: Downgrade after turns
downgradeAfterTurns.description: Consecutive lower verdicts needed before stepping down a tier

maxTokensForHaiku.title: Max context tokens for haiku
maxTokensForHaiku.description: Above this many prompt tokens the session never drops to haiku

maxTokensForDowngrade.title: Max context tokens for any downgrade
maxTokensForDowngrade.description: Above this many prompt tokens the tier only goes up: re-billing a large context outside the cache costs more than a cheaper model saves

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: Model that labels each prompt's complexity

classifierTimeoutMs.title: Classifier timeout (ms)
classifierTimeoutMs.description: Keep the current tier when the classifier takes longer than this

tierModels.title: Model id per tier
tierModels.description: Full model ids to send, e.g. fable=claude-fable-5-1,opus=claude-opus-5-5,sonnet=claude-sonnet-5-5,haiku=claude-haiku-5-5 (aliases are not resolved on this path)

maxAutoTier.title: Highest automatic tier
maxAutoTier.description: The highest tier the classifier, subagent routing and the model's set_tier may pick (fable|opus|sonnet|haiku). Fable has its own rate limit on Claude Teams, so it is reserved for /tier fable by default

routeEffort.title: Route effort
routeEffort.description: Also classify each prompt's reasoning effort (low..xhigh) and send requests with it; the model may correct it with set_tier

providerTierModels.title: Tier model per provider
providerTierModels.description: When the router (e.g. cc-router) answers on another provider, what to send for each tier: openai=fable:codex,opus:codex,sonnet:default,haiku:default;ollama=… (empty tiers keep whatever answered)
